thread:
Anna (docs): Quick check please 1 opened a lightweight troubleshooting note for 429 responses and SDK fallbacks. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482. Want a fast pass before merge.

Kevin (eng): pinged. Which file did you drop it under?

Anna (docs): docs/errors/429.md. It has a tiny example showing backoff + switching to a routing alias (not a real SDK arg). Also a note about trimming context windows.

Lisa (sdk): can you paste the Python snippet you added? I'll translate to Go and TS.

Anna (docs): pasted snippet here:
```python
# illustrative example only - routing alias used for fallback
resp = client.generate(
  model='alias:llm-fallback',
  prompt=user_prompt,
)
```

Kevin (eng): good — please don't present `fallback_model` as an SDK param (we don't support that). Add an explicit callout that the "alias" is configured via Console routing policies.

Anna (docs): will update the copy to make that explicit and add a Console JSON example for the routing rule.

Sam (product): also add a short note about how context-limit trimming can look like a failure. Lots of customers mistake truncation or 413 for a 429.

Lisa (sdk): I'll add TS/Go snippets. TS example I plan to use:
```ts
const resp = await client.generate({
  model: 'alias:llm-fallback',
  input: prompt,
})
```

Anna (docs): added a link to the context limits doc but the path I used (/docs/models/context-limits) 404s. Can someone confirm the canonical URL?

Kevin (eng): created https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/211 to track the missing page. Use /docs/platform/limits/context as the canonical link for now.

Anna (docs): updated link. Also added a short failure-mode table (429 vs 504 vs timeout) for quick triage. Can someone sanity-check the phrasing?

Kevin (eng): table wording looks fine. Suggest shorter phrasing: "429: rate or concurrency limit - try backoff, batching, or routing to a smaller model."

Lisa (sdk): PR looks good after removing the erroneous param. I'll follow up with a separate PR for Go snippets and an SDK docs note on alias usage.

merge-bot: PR #482 auto-approved by lisa, merge scheduled in 5m :white_check_mark:

Anna (docs): thanks. Adding a tiny Dedicated note about queueing and service tiers. Kevin: could you add a small curl example for checking Retry-After header?

Kevin (eng): sure, add something like:
```bash
curl -i https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \\
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \\
  | grep -i 'retry-after'
```

Anna (docs): added that curl snippet and a short note about interpreting Retry-After values vs exponential backoff. Pushed final change at 1762240178.

Lisa (sdk): I'll open follow-up PRs for language-specific snippets and an SDK guidance blurb about not exposing routing config as SDK params. :rocket:
